title: Odoo 3CX CRM Connector | 3CX Phone System Integration with Odoo | Click-to-Call, Call Popup & Call Logging
author: Creyox Technologies
summary: The 3CX CRM Odoo Connector delivers a powerful, automated communication solution by seamlessly integrating 3CX VoIP, call management, and live chat directly into Odoo CRM. This integration enables businesses to handle incoming calls, outgoing calls, and real-time chat conversations inside Odoo, improving workflow efficiency and customer interaction. Unknown numbers are instantly converted into new Contacts, with every call detail—timestamps, duration, and call status—automatically logged in the chatter. Missed calls generate scheduled activities, ensuring timely follow-ups and preventing lost opportunities. Live chat visitors are captured as contacts, and conversations are recorded for complete communication history. The connector also supports automatic creation of Contacts, Leads, or both, intelligently deciding where to log each interaction. Activities are auto-assigned based on 3CX extension matching, and all user extensions can be fully managed within Odoo. With centralized call logs, chat history, and lead tracking, the module enhances sales productivity, customer experience, and communication accuracy, making it an essential 3CX–Odoo integration for modern businesses.

title: All In One Barcode
author: INKERP
summary: The All In One Barcode app for Odoo is a comprehensive barcode-driven productivity module designed to simplify and accelerate everyday business operations across sales, purchasing, inventory, and manufacturing. By enabling real-time barcode scanning, this solution allows users to instantly add products to sales orders, purchase orders, customer invoices, stock pickings, delivery orders, receipts, and Bills of Materials (BOM) without any manual searching or repetitive line creation. Each scan automatically inserts the correct product, updates quantities, and applies accurate pricing, ensuring faster order processing with minimal effort. Built to work seamlessly within Odoo’s core modules, the app significantly reduces human errors, improves data accuracy, and enhances operational efficiency, making it ideal for warehouses, retail environments, and high-volume order processing businesses. In addition to speed and convenience, the All In One Barcode app strengthens inventory control and manufacturing workflows by keeping stock levels and BOM quantities perfectly synchronized through barcode actions. Smart warning messages alert users about missing barcodes, insufficient stock, or duplicate product entries before mistakes occur, helping businesses maintain clean and reliable data. Whether managing incoming receipts, outgoing deliveries, internal stock movements, or manufacturing components, this barcode integration ensures smooth and error-free execution at every stage. Overall, the module empowers Odoo users to boost productivity, streamline warehouse operations, improve order accuracy, and gain better control over inventory and manufacturing processes using a single, unified barcode scanning solution. title: CRM Lead View Type Restriction
author: INKERP
summary: CRM View Type Restriction provides a simple and effective way to control the View Type option in the CRM Lead interface of Odoo. It allows administrators to manage the visibility of the View Type option for individual users. When the restriction is enabled, the View Type option is removed from the CRM Lead interface for the selected user. This prevents users from changing or selecting different view types from the CRM Lead screen. Administrators can configure this restriction according to user roles and business requirements. The module works independently of existing CRM access rights and standard Odoo security permissions. It helps maintain a cleaner and more controlled CRM interface for users. The restriction focuses only on the visibility of the View Type option without modifying standard CRM workflows. This module does not restrict individual CRM view types such as List, Kanban, Calendar, or Graph. Overall, CRM View Type Restriction offers flexible control over View Type option visibility in Odoo CRM Leads.

title: Fleet Vehicle View Type Restriction
author: INKERP
summary: Fleet Vehicle View Type Restriction provides an efficient solution for managing the View Type option in the Odoo Fleet module. It enables administrators to control the availability of the View Type option for individual users based on their roles and responsibilities. When the restriction is enabled, the View Type option is hidden from the selected user's Fleet Vehicle interface. This prevents users from changing or selecting different vehicle views directly from the interface. Administrators can apply the restriction without modifying existing Fleet access rights or standard Odoo security permissions. The module helps maintain a clean, consistent, and user-focused Fleet Vehicle interface. It provides user-specific control while keeping standard Fleet functionality unchanged. The restriction works alongside existing Odoo permissions without affecting normal vehicle access management. This feature focuses only on View Type option visibility and does not restrict individual Fleet Vehicle views. Overall, Fleet Vehicle View Type Restriction offers a practical way to manage view selection and improve interface control in Odoo Fleet.

title: Pre-Order & Incoming Purchase Order Reservation for Odoo | Advanced Incoming Purchase Reservation System | Reserve Products from Incoming Purchase Orders
author: Vraja Technologies
summary: In many industries such as wholesale distribution, electronics, automotive parts, and manufacturing, customers often want to secure products before they arrive in the warehouse. Businesses frequently receive advance orders from customers while the stock is still on the way from suppliers. The Pre-Order & Incoming Purchase Order Reservation module for Odoo allows businesses to reserve product quantities directly from open purchase orders. Customers and internal sales teams can easily view incoming stock, expected arrival dates, and available quantities and reserve items in advance. Once the purchase order is received, the system automatically prioritizes and allocates the stock to the reserved customers. This helps businesses avoid overselling, improve customer satisfaction, and ensure fair allocation of limited inventory. The module includes an intelligent Reservation Expiry Management System to ensure that reserved inventory does not remain blocked indefinitely. Once the purchase order is received and the goods arrive in the warehouse, the system automatically sends an email notification to the customer informing them that their reserved items are now available. Customers are requested to confirm or cancel their reservation within a defined period (10 days). author: 永
summary: Multi language content translation for odoo Currently, a multilingual content translation application module is built based on the Baidu API interface; This module consists of three main parts: translation function, API interface function, and language control group Translation function: mainly obtains field content for specified text language translation; API interface function: Provides Baidu online interface, users only need to open the translation API interface on the official website of Baidu Translation Platform, obtain the APP ID and key to use the interface function; Language control group: Due to the differences between the language codes provided by Odoo and the online API interface, as well as the language codes of various platform interfaces, the corresponding relationship between Odoo language environment codes and API interface language environment codes is provided to achieve more accurate translation; 1. Added Youdao Cloud API translation interface, supporting platform interface switching and usage 2. Modify the API interface to return data styles, optimize the judgment of returned translation data, and add a pop-up function for abnormal translation data 3. Added iFlytek text translation interface, Add user operation prompts, Optimize translation error prompts, 4. Optimize the default sorting of the language control group 5. Add default search filter view 6. Add a new Xiaoniu Text Translation API interface 7. Add Tencent Cloud Text Translation API interface 8. Add volcano text translation 9. Add Alibaba Cloud Text Translation 10. Add iFlytek's Niutrans interface as the default machine translation interface 11. New feature: Multi-field selection translation, allowing multiple translatable fields to be selected for data translation 12. Add a prompt for the completion of new function translation and display the translation time 13. Update Xiaoniu Translation to use batch translation to speed up translation 14. Update Alibaba Cloud Translation for batch translation to enhance translation speed 15. Introducing Tencent Cloud Machine Translation - batch translation to enhance translation speed 16. Optimize volcano text translation - batch translation to improve translation speed 17. The translation interface has added a list length definition function, which allows for setting the appropriate list length based on the interface platform reference. 18. Update Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Xiaoniu, and Huoshan translation interfaces to use machine batch translation by default, which can improve translation speed

summary: Veterinary Management is a complete Odoo solution designed to simplify the management of veterinary clinics, pet hospitals, and pet care centers. The module allows users to maintain detailed pet profiles, including feeding schedules, medications, vaccinations, insurance information, bedtime routines, medical conditions, and customizable question-and-answer records. It provides an efficient workflow for managing pet appointments, boarding, services, and transportation from a single platform. The system automatically generates invoices for boarding, services, and transportation, reducing manual billing efforts. Users can generate professional PDF reports for pet details, appointments, boarding, services, and transportation records whenever required. It also includes dedicated history reports for boarding, service, and transportation activities, making it easy to track previous records. Administrators can configure default invoice products directly from the application settings for consistent invoicing. The module also supports default terms and conditions that are automatically applied to appointments, boarding, services, transportation, and related documents. With its centralized workflow, automation features, and comprehensive reporting capabilities, Veterinary Management helps improve operational efficiency, reduce administrative work, and deliver better pet care services.
